text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — in the weekly KPI deck I noticed webinar -> trial conversion dipped from 4.2% to 2.8% yesterday. dashboard looks off, can someone sanity-check?

mike: which dashboard? Looker or HubSpot?

elaine: Looker funnel: https://redwood.looker.com/dashboards/#!/webinar_funnel  - numbers there don't match HubSpot pipeline counts.

sophia: :eyes: I saw that too. Also paid channel CTR was flat; suspect attribution / UTM mismatch.

raj: I pulled raw events: Segment shows 1,200 webinar_signups yesterday, HS shows 980 new contacts. Might be dedupe or bad event mapping.

analytics-bot: Alert: `webinar_signups` event schema changed at 2026-03-20T23:12:05Z — missing `utm_source` in ~18% of events.

dena: we did a small landing form update last night (form id changed). @mike did you update the Segment form tracker?

mike: nope — I intentionally left it for today. that explains missing utm. will patch now.

raj: I can run a quick SQL to reconcile. running query against events_raw to compare distinct contact_ids.

raj: SQL snippet:
```
select utm_source, count(*) from events_raw
where event = 'webinar_signup' and created_at >= '2026-03-20'
group by 1;
```

sophia: timeline? we need numbers for the KPI review in 40m.

mike: patch in 10m, deploy 5m, will post confirmation.

raj: will run recompute and push corrected counts to Looker once patch is live. if dedupe in HS is the problem, I'll flag with ops.

elaine: great — please post final number in this thread. Also can we add a one-liner in the KPI deck: "drop due to tag/form update; working on reconciliation"? keeps execs happy.

dena: I'll draft copy.

analytics-bot: Job complete: ingestion-backfill finished, +210 restored events. updated dashboard caches.

raj: post-fix numbers: Looker funnel now shows 1,180 signups -> trial conversion 3.9% (reconciled with HS). still a small drop vs prior week but not as large as first reported.

sophia: thanks — add to notes: attribute ~0.3% of delta to landing copy A/B winning, rest is seasonal noise.

elaine: excellent. action items: (1) mike confirm tracker code deployed, (2) raj add reconciliation note in Looker, (3) sophia prepare KPI slide. I'll mark done when deck updated.

mike: deployed ✅

raj: reconciliation note added to dashboard, link updated.

sophia: slide updated and in the weekly deck.

elaine: closing thread — thanks team :tada:
